name: samatva
description: Agent Skills (SKILL.md) for staying steady in a hard conversation, starting with vent and before-you-send: say you're angry and it listens, with no advice, until you're calmer; ask for an angry message and it holds it until tomorrow. Works mid-conversation with any agent that reads SKILL.md.

plugins.name: samatva
plugins.description: De-escalation skills: vent listens while you're angry, replying only with reflections of your own words, with no advice, options, or labels for anyone. before-you-send holds an angry message until tomorrow and, if you insist, only strips accusations, absolutes, threats, and labels from your own text. Restraint rules live in the skill text, with an optional script and an eval set to measure whether your host model holds them.
